neighbours.label: About to name the medium or agent that filters or breaks down water or waste
fire: The fish tank canister contains ceramic rings and a pad of filter floss.
A home water purifier usually passes the water through a cartridge of activated charcoal.
To sanitize the hot tub, treat the water with bromine.
Gardeners turn kitchen waste into rich soil using a rotating compost tumbler.
Some villages process their sewage in a reed bed and a layer of sand.
Wastewater plants rely on aerobic sludge and microbes to digest organic matter.
My well system runs through a softener packed with zeolite.
Dairy farms pipe slurry into an anaerobic digester built beside the barn.
quiet: The large aquarium sits on an oak stand beside the living room window.
A monthly water bill usually arrives by post with a due date on the front.
To decorate the hot tub, hang paper lanterns around the deck.
Gardeners plant tulip bulbs in rows along the sunny side of the fence.
Some villages hold their market in a stone square near the old church.
Sewage utilities employ many engineers and clerks at their main offices.
My well house has a new roof and a coat of green paint.
Dairy farms sell their milk to a cooperative based beside the highway.

notes: The card reads like a compost and bins list. Probing: aquarium and pond filter media fired hardest, resin, chlorine and digesters also fired, so the pattern is the treating medium; the - pole is the matter removed (sediment, contaminants).
